title: Insight discordance differentiates behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia from false positives
title_zh: 洞察不一致可区分行为型额颞叶痴呆与假阳性病例
abstract: Abstract Behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) can present with behavioural symptoms similar to psychiatric mimics of the disease (sometimes termed ‘phenocopies’). Despite this overlap, loss of insight is a cardinal feature of bvFTD unlike most psychiatric disorders. This study tested whether insight could be quantified to improve diagnostic accuracy in distinguishing these conditions, and examined neuroimaging correlates of impaired insight. In this prospective cohort study, 27 patients with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) presenting as the bvFTD phenotype and 25 false-positives of bvFTD who ultimately had a psychiatric disorder underwent patient, informant, and clinician symptom ratings on a modified Frontal Behavioural Inventory (FBI). Discrepancy scores were calculated, diagnostic discrimination was evaluated by area under the curve (AUC) with leave-one-out cross-validation, alongside a neuroimaging analysis of network-level associations of insight in bvFTD. Patients with bvFTD endorsed fewer symptoms than false-positives (FBI 6.62 ± 8.80 vs 15.36 ± 8.42, P < 0.001), whereas clinician observations were markedly greater in bvFTD (27.67 ± 8.35 vs 5.64 ± 3.85, P < 0.001). Informant ratings did not differ between groups (25.15 ± 11.11 vs 21.32 ± 12.61, P = 0.14), even though bvFTD informants had more knowledge of the disease (FTD Knowledge Scale 16.20 ± 6.68 vs 9.41 ± 8.19, P = 0.003). A model incorporating patient–clinician and informant–clinician discrepancy showed excellent cross-validated discrimination (AUC 0.99, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.97–1.00). A model independent of expert clinician ratings, the patient–informant discrepancy, showed fair cross-validated discrimination across the full cohort (AUC 0.71, 95% CI 0.56–0.85) and good discrimination in those who did not develop another FTLD syndrome on follow-up (‘pure bvFTD’; AUC 0.78, 95% CI 0.63–0.94). In bvFTD, reduced insight was associated with salience and semantic appraisal network degeneration but not control frontotemporal regions. BvFTD, false-positives, and their informants demonstrated opposing patterns of symptom endorsement. Symptom under-endorsement (lack of insight) by patients relative to clinician and informant observation supports neurodegeneration, whereas informant and patient over-endorsement without clinician-observed disturbance suggests a false-positive. Unfamiliarity with bvFTD may contribute to over-reporting. Though the clinician-dependent findings may not translate to non-expert settings, the patient–informant model retained good discrimination. Formal quantification of discrepancy patterns in behaviour may reduce misdiagnosis in bvFTD. The neuroimaging findings support salience and semantic appraisal networks as the neuroanatomical basis for insight in bvFTD. Future studies should validate the FBI clinician version and examine factors underlying over-reporting by false-positives and their informants.
abstract_zh: 摘要 行为型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）可表现出与该疾病精神病模拟者（有时称为“表型拷贝”）相似的行为症状。尽管存在此类重叠，但洞察力丧失是bvFTD的核心特征，与大多数精神疾病不同。本研究检验了洞察力是否可定量，以提高鉴别这些疾病的诊断准确性，并探讨了洞察力受损的神经影像学相关物。在这项前瞻性队列研究中，27例表现为bvFTD表型的额颞叶变性（FTLD）患者和25例最终确诊为精神障碍的bvFTD假阳性病例，接受了患者、信息提供者和临床医生对修订版额叶行为量表（FBI）的症状评分。计算了差异得分，并通过留一法交叉验证下曲线下面积（AUC）评估诊断鉴别力，同时进行了bvFTD中洞察力网络水平关联的神经影像学分析。与假阳性病例相比，bvFTD患者自我认可的症状更少（FBI 6.62±8.80 对 15.36±8.42，P＜0.001），而临床医生观察在bvFTD中明显更高（27.67±8.35 对 5.64±3.85，P＜0.001）。信息提供者评分两组无差异（25.15±11.11 对 21.32±12.61，P=0.14），尽管bvFTD的信息提供者对疾病认知更多（FTD知识量表 16.20±6.68 对 9.41±8.19，P=0.003）。包含患者—临床医生和信息提供者—临床医生差异的模型显示出极佳的交叉验证鉴别力（AUC 0.99，95%置信区间[CI] 0.97–1.00）。一个不依赖专家临床医生评分的模型，即患者—信息提供者差异，在整个队列中显示出中等的交叉验证鉴别力（AUC 0.71，95% CI 0.56–0.85），在随访期间未发展为另一种FTLD综合征（“纯bvFTD”）的患者中显示出良好鉴别力（AUC 0.78，95% CI 0.63–0.94）。在bvFTD中，洞察力降低与显著性网络和语义评价网络退化相关，而与控制性额颞叶区域无关。bvFTD、假阳性病例及其信息提供者表现出相反的症状背书模式。相对于临床医生和信息提供者观察，患者症状报告不足（缺乏洞察力）支持神经变性，而信息提供者和患者过度报告却无临床医生观察到的扰动则提示假阳性。对bvFTD不熟悉可能导致过度报告。尽管临床医生依赖性发现可能无法推广至非专家环境，但患者—信息提供者模型保持了良好的鉴别力。行为中差异模式的正式量化可能减少bvFTD的误诊。神经影像学发现支持显著性和语义评价网络作为bvFTD中洞察力的神经解剖学基础。未来研究应验证FBI临床医生版本，并探讨假阳性病例及其信息提供者过度报告的潜在因素。
